titulo.estudio: やっと と ついに
titulo.alumno: Qualifying an expected result: «やっと» and «ついに»

intro: Look at the pattern in short examples and check what information it gives in context.

piezas.titulo: «やっと» highlights that something was achieved after difficulty or waiting; «ついに» marks the final outcome, positive or negative.
texto: «とうとう» also presents a result at the end of a process. Don't always translate these adverbs as "at last": watch how the context evaluates it.
なんど も しっぱい した が、 やっと せいこう しました。 (I failed several times, but I finally succeeded.)
ちょうさ の すえ、 ついに げんいん が わかりました。 (After the investigation, the cause was finally found.)
